behaviors.description: Search independently prepared AppStream description text.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user remote with A query metadata.
behaviors.expected: A-only keyword returns exactly Query; B-only and missing keywords return no matches; no deployments.

behaviors.description: Refresh a specified remote's changed AppStream data.
behaviors.preconditions: Cached A descriptions and independently exported B descriptions served at the same URL.
behaviors.expected: Search remains A before refresh, then returns B-only text and excludes A-only text after explicit refresh, without deployments.

behaviors.description: Install an unsigned single-file bundle with explicit format selection.
behaviors.preconditions: Required runtime installed; bundle copied to an extensionless case-local filename; bundle app absent and unavailable from configured remote.
behaviors.expected: Without --bundle the input fails without deployment; with --bundle its exact app commit is installed, runtime preserved and companion absent.

behaviors.description: Filter installed apps by their declared runtime.
behaviors.preconditions: Two installed apps use distinct prepared runtimes.
behaviors.expected: Each runtime selects only its app; missing runtime selects none.

behaviors.description: Unset languages and observe locale payload selection.
behaviors.preconditions: Locale-subset extension with de/fr/ja/es markers; current language fr, extra-languages de, explicit languages ja.
behaviors.expected: Initial deployment contains only ja. After uninstall and unset, deployment contains de and fr, excluding ja and es; extra-languages persists.

mappings.rationale: Unique description-only keyword matches exactly the prepared app ID, with B-only and nonexistent terms excluded.
Same remote URL switches A to B; searches prove cached A before explicit --appstream refresh and B-only results with A excluded afterward.

An independently exported bundle is copied to an extensionless filename. Installation without --bundle fails without changing installed refs; explicit --bundle installs its exact app commit, preserves the runtime and leaves the companion absent.
Two installed apps use different runtimes. Each --app-runtime query returns precisely its app and excludes its competitor; missing runtime returns none.
Public info deployment locations expose locale marker payloads. Explicit ja overrides current fr and extra de; after --unset languages, a fresh deployment contains de/fr and excludes ja/es.
